is_anopheles.evidence: The study investigates Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles arabiensis as described in the Abstract and Mosquito collections section on page 2.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study genotypes the Vgsc L1014F (L995F) kdr mutation and the ace-1R (G119S / G280S) mutation as described in the Abstract and the 'Molecular analysis' section on page 3.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 4 and Table 5 on page 7 provide the exact genotype counts (SS, RS, RR) and allele frequencies for kdr L1014F and ace-1R across the different species and locations.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from the field in Bobo-Dioulasso, Burkina Faso, West Africa, between May and December 2008 (page 2, 'Study areas' and 'Mosquito collections').

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an original empirical study reporting field collections, WHO susceptibility bioassays, and molecular genotyping.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study provides specific coordinates and names for two districts in Bobo-Dioulasso: Dioulassoba (11°10'42"N; 4°17'35"W) and Kodéni (11°10'N; 4°15'W) on page 2.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquito collections were conducted from May to December 2008 (page 2, 'Mosquito collections').

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes routine local entomological monitoring and does not indicate any sample overlap with larger consortia or previously published datasets.

assessment.summary: This study reports on the species composition, Plasmodium infection rates, and insecticide resistance status of Anopheles gambiae s.l. in Bobo-Dioulasso, Burkina Faso, in 2008. It provides detailed genotype counts and frequencies for the Vgsc L1014F (L995F) and Ace-1 G119S (G280S) mutations in An. arabiensis, An. gambiae S form, and An. gambiae M form, alongside WHO tube bioassay results.
